description: This Java source file defines the AuthHelper class, which manages authentication processes such as login, logout, user synchronization, and password updates within the Apache OFBiz framework. It loads authenticators dynamically using ServiceLoader and provides static methods for authentication-related operations.

classes.name: AuthHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for authentication management, including loading authenticators, performing authentication, logout, synchronization, and password updates within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication by iterating through loaded authenticators; throws exception if authenticators are not loaded.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user by invoking logout on all loaded authenticators.

methods.name: syncUser
methods.description: Synchronizes user data across authenticators if supported.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password across all authenticators.

methods.name: loadAuthenticators
methods.description: Loads authenticators dynamically using ServiceLoader if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadAuthenticatorsInternal
methods.description: Internal synchronized method to load and initialize authenticators, sort them, and set the loaded flag.

methods.name: getContextClassLoader
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's context class loader with security privileges.
